proposals: The Department of Economic Affairs should publish an official consolidated text of the Non-Debt Instruments Rules after every amendment, with a table listing each of the amendments and the clauses it changed, so a rule amended nineteen times since 2019 need not be reconstructed from gazette OCR.

CBIC should add a shipping-bill declaration identifying exports made by e-commerce entities under the new clause 15.2.5 inventory route, and DGCI&S should publish monthly totals, so the volume moving through the carve-out can be measured rather than remaining, as the post says, a legal change not yet measured.

DPIIT should publish each year how many foreign-funded e-commerce entities have adopted the export-only inventory model and the FDI they received for it, so the take-up of the first exception to the 2018 inventory ban is visible.

DGFT should publish annual e-commerce export values, including courier consignments under the ₹10 lakh cap, against Foreign Trade Policy 2023's $200–300 billion ambition for 2030, so progress toward the target the carve-out is meant to serve can be tracked.
